feature: Custom categories and conservative local category automation
behavior: Transaksi/Impor: Kelola kategori adds/removes active names and edits/adds/deletes literal keyword rules.
Removed categories remain on historical entries; their rules become inactive until category reactivation.
New imports automatically fill fresh uncategorized rows when one clear category matches; manual edits remain authoritative.
Conflicting categories, payment rails, cash movements, refunds and unresolved types remain suggestions.
Existing history requires explicit preview and apply; no automation on startup or backup restoration.
Source descriptions are preferred over edited notes; money, types, dates, source facts and IDs remain unchanged.
Batch category writes update annotations through the existing revision-guarded writer; failed writes retain recovery drafts.
Rules compile once per import/history batch; suggestions are deduplicated by category.

settings.concurrency: Captured raw settings token plus Web Locks CAS; stale saves rejected.
settings.backup: Separate validated settings export/import; financial backups retain category strings but do not include the catalog/rules.

covered_failures: Invalid and oversized settings imports leave current settings and financial data intact.
Settings quota errors and concurrent saves retain draft; pending close/edit paths are guarded.
Financial quota failure preserves old stored bytes; draft export and global retry save category batch exactly once.
A remote manual category change rejects stale automatic apply and retry; loading latest preserves the remote choice.
Category batch capacity rejection is atomic at the existing8MiB financial boundary.
limits: Literal rules are editable merchant heuristics, not an AI guarantee of the purpose of every purchase.
Unknown merchants and ambiguous descriptions stay uncategorized until a user rule or manual decision.
Chromium on Windows with mobile emulation; no physical-device or manual screen-reader verification.
Contrast covers sampled visible steady-state solid text/control/placeholder states; gradients and disabled controls excluded.

Full performance, recovery, source-lifecycle and backfill suites were not repeated as whole suites for this feature; earlier results remain historical. Targeted category source/recovery/conflict cases passed.
CI configuration includes the new gate; remote CI was not executed.

user_sample.inspection: Provided backup validated and rule matches simulated in memory only.

review_corrections: NFC-equivalent category names now collide during validation.
Full settings export envelope is budgeted so a valid saved configuration can be exported and restored.
Explicit batch compilation replaces mutable-object caching after a unit test caught stale rules.
Duplicate-category suggestions are merged, and failed category save UI explains the global retry path.
packaging: New combined ZIP and off-PC backup remain deferred by user; old snapshots retained.
